faq.d: Prices, shipping, install and warranty in Colombia.
faq.q1: How much does a security camera cost?
faq.a1: WiFi from $120,000, dome from $160,000, bullet from $180,000, PTZ from $1,200,000 COP, by resolution (2MP/4MP/8MP) and brand.
faq.q2: How long is delivery in Colombia?
faq.a2: In stock: 1–3 business days nationwide. Made-to-order/import: 5–10 business days by model and quantity.
faq.a3: Yes. Main capitals: 1–3 business days. Other cities: 3–7 business days. Install is optional, quoted with the kit.
faq.a4: All carry manufacturer warranty plus tech support in Colombia.
faq.a5: Colombia's most common: Hikvision, Dahua, Ezviz, HiLook and UNV.
faq.q6: Can I watch from my phone?
faq.a6: Yes. All kits and WiFi cams include a mobile app (Android/iOS) with real-time video, two-way audio and alerts.
faq.q7: What does a DVR/NVR kit include?
faq.a7: Recorder (4/8/16ch DVR or NVR), HDD (1TB–4TB), cameras per kit and remote app access.
faq.a8: WiFi: easy install, best indoors. Wired (PoE): steadier, up to 90 m, best outdoors and warehouses.
faq.side_d: Send 3 facade + gate photos. Camera map + quote in 24 h.
